question: **Which of the following is NOT true of Nikhil Srivastava according to the passage?**

options.text: He had his education in many countries around the world.
He is now a faculty at the University of California.
He was born in North India in the early 1980s.
He has served as the Indian ambassador to Denmark and Uganda.

solution:
The correct answer is: **He has served as the Indian ambassador to Denmark and Uganda.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The fist sentence of the third paragraph in the given passage states that- *"An Indian national, Nikhil was born in New Delhi in November 1983 and has attended educational institutions across the world - Syria, UK, Saudi Arabia, and US__" *Therefore, option 1 is true according to the passage.
 
• The first sentence of the first paragraph in the given passage states that- *__"Indian mathematician Nikhil Srivastava, working at the University of California in Berkeley"__ *Therefore, option 2 is true according to the passage.
 
• The first sentence of the third paragraph in the given passage states that- *__"An Indian national, Nikhil was born in New Delhi in November 1983 "__ *we know that **Delhi falls in the north-central part of India,*** *Therefore, option 3 is true according to the passage.
 
• The second sentence of the third paragraph in the given passage states that- **__"his father was an Indian Foreign Services Officer, who has served as the Indian ambassador to Uganda and Denmark."__** Therefore, **option 4 is not true according to the passage.**

From here we can conclude that option 4, which is not true according to the passage is the right answer.
